notReached: A publish already in flight when NATS freezes was not caught on the real surface in 3 trials: the silent-cut detection marked the bus disconnected before the announcer's pass, so the pass skipped the publish. residualRisks: The state cookie can be replayed for its 10 minutes; only the issuer's single-use code stops a second callback.
A request whose confirmation has lapsed waits for the refresh timeout (about 15 s) while the issuer does not answer, then answers 503.
A process refused at boot holds its bound port without serving for up to about 20 s before it exits.
